title: When the Cipher Falls Revisited
author: O. M. Crane
blurb: Odile Iversen, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
